title: Catching the Imposter: Self-Supervised Learning of Physical Coherence with Cross-Entity Feature Permutations
abstract: arXiv:2608.14372v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific data often describe entities whose features are jointly governed by the laws of physics, yet existing self-supervised learning (SSL) objectives largely ignore this physical coherence. We introduce imposter, a discriminative pretext task that replaces subsets of an entity's features with real observations donated by another entity and trains the encoder to identify the swapped features. Because every donated value is individually plausible, the task can only be solved by learning cross-feature physical dependencies. We evaluate the proposed objectives on global ERA5-Land reanalysis data using 21 environmental variables and assess the learned representations on seven downstream tasks spanning climate classification, carbon flux estimation, and streamflow prediction. Our study includes, to our knowledge, the first systematic comparison of self-supervised objectives for land-surface modeling under a shared architecture and pre-tra

translated_title: 捕捉冒名者：通过跨实体特征置换进行物理一致性的自监督学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14372v1 公告类型：新 摘要：科学数据通常描述由物理定律共同支配其特征的实体，但现有的自监督学习（SSL）目标在很大程度上忽略了这种物理一致性。我们引入了“imposter”这一判别性预文本任务，该任务将实体的特征子集替换为另一个实体捐赠的真实观测值，并训练编码器识别被替换的特征。由于每个捐赠值在个体上都是合理的，该任务只能通过学习跨特征的物理依赖性来解决。我们在全球ERA5-Land再分析数据上，使用21个环境变量评估了所提出的目标，并在涵盖气候分类、碳通量估计和河流流量预测的七项下游任务上评估了学习到的表示。我们的研究包括，据我们所知，在共享架构和预训练设置下，对地表建模自监督目标的首次系统比较。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“imposter”的自监督预文本任务，通过跨实体特征置换来捕捉物理一致性，并在ERA5-Land数据上验证了其在多项下游任务中的有效性，首次系统比较了地表建模中的SSL目标。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "imposter," a self-supervised pretext task that captures physical coherence via cross-entity feature permutations, validated on ERA5-Land data across multiple downstream tasks, providing the first systematic comparison of SSL objectives for land-surface modeling.
